newsitem.title: ITALY: British Airways cargo flight to serve Pisa.
newsitem.headline: British Airways cargo flight to serve Pisa.

text.p: British Airways said it will inaugurate a weekly all-cargo flight from Pisa's Amerigo Vespucci airport on the Tel Aviv-Pisa-London Gatwick route from April 1.
The new bi-weekly connection, using a 737-400 freighter, will be the first time BA will be operating a cargo flight in Italy under the fifth freedom.
Fifth freedom rights allow airlines on arrival in a country to pick up cargo or passengers for a destination in a third country.

A spokesman for SAT, the Pisa airport management company, said: "BA, in establishing this new connection, has reconfirmed the validity of the Pisa airport in operative terms and in terms of facilities and, indirectly, the potential of export cargo traffic from the hinterland the Pisa airport serves." - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
